content.text: Intro and TLDR: What is the Atmosphere
The Atmosphere is an ecosystem of social networking apps that all use Atmosphere accounts so that:
One account logs you in to all Atmosphere apps
Apps can seamlessly integrate with each other
Apps cannot lock you in and extract you for profit
Currently, Bluesky is the flagship social network in the Atmosphere but many exist and are growing! Start using any of these today by logging in with your Atmosphere/Bluesky account.
Your Atmosphere account (also called a PDS) is:
A place that stores the content you create on the apps and the people you have relationships with (follows, followers, mutuals, etc.)
If you're curious about what this looks like, go to
and search for your handle. You'll be looking at a big data dump of your content. Click around and you'll see everyone you follow and all the posts, likes, reposts, etc you've ever made on Bluesky!
If you use other Atmosphere apps, those will show up here too!

content.text: How do I make an account?
Your Bluesky account IS an Atmosphere account!
You can (and should) use it to log into any Atmosphere app!
If you don't want to make your account on Bluesky, you can also create one on some other Atmosphere apps like
the app you made the account on. Only you can create and change things in it.

content.text: Why is the Atmosphere so good?
Once you've made an Atmosphere account, use it for ANY Atmosphere app. It's so convenient!
If you made an account on Bluesky, that's an Atmosphere account. Just use the handle you made there to log into Leaflet, Semble, Tangled, or anywhere else.

content.text: Legacy social media companies seem amazing at first, but once they get enough users, it's all about profit extraction. They're no longer making a product in your best interest. You want to leave but they've locked in all your friends and content, so you're stuck. Twitter/X and Instagram stand out as recent examples.

. Let's say an app stops serving you, gets bogged down in ads, changes its algorithm, or supports questionable causes. A competitor will emerge and you can just start using that app instead. Your same content and your same friends, no starting over again. Just totally seamless.

content.text: The Atmosphere is an ecosystem of apps that use Atmosphere accounts.
An Atmosphere account exists outside of any single app. It consists of a username and a big folder of all the content and relationships a person has. It's public!

Atmosphere apps use this folder to create social experiences like blogging, tweeting, and sharing. Because everything is public, Atmosphere apps can create uniquely seamless experiences between themselves!
Finally, if an app fails to meet your standards, you can always leave the app without leaving your connections and your content.
